# FiniteCounts.OffsetWord

**Checked translation words and random offsets**

Actual checked finite-group translation/binary-scalar execution, exact failure sets, uniform nonzero PMF probability and four-exception union bounds.

**边界**：Uses actual finite group cardinality; no automatic Hasse/subgroup-size estimate, fixed-offset guarantee or quantum-fidelity conclusion.

**覆盖等级**：B
